title: ageratina lasia
intro: Ageratina lasia, commonly known as Mexican Cinnamon, is a perennial plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina lasia include its ability to treat digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Ageratina lasia include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
